methodology.nrmse: mean per-run nRMSE within each seed, then mean and sample SD across seeds
methodology.melt_mae: pooled over true 1800-2000 K node/frame pairs within each seed
methodology.iou: pooled area-weighted intersections divided by pooled unions within each seed
methodology.energy_a: median over runs of peak absolute energy error divided by cumulative source input, gated at 5% of total source input
methodology.energy_end: median signed final energy error divided by total source input over runs, then mean and sample SD across seeds
methodology.diagnostics: Q-weighted ratios over contiguous direction-labelled legs; seed 0, one straight, one L-turn and one zigzag example
